articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 500K Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a 500,000-token context window and an improved extended thinking mode that rivals leading models on complex multi-step tasks. The model demonstrates significant gains on math and coding benchmarks, scoring 92% on AIME 2025. Enterprise customers gain immediate access, with consumer rollout expected within the week.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Agent Framework Now Open to Third-Party Developers
articles.summary: Google DeepMind opened its Gemini Agent Framework to external developers, allowing teams to build autonomous multi-agent pipelines using Gemini Ultra 2.5 as the orchestration backbone. The SDK includes built-in tool-use APIs, memory modules, and sandboxed execution environments. The announcement drew immediate comparisons to OpenAI's Operator platform, intensifying competition in the agentic AI space.

articles.title: OpenAI GPT-5 Fine-Tuning API Launches with Reinforcement Learning Support
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its fine-tuning API to include reinforcement learning from human feedback capabilities, letting enterprises customize GPT-5 for domain-specific tasks without building reward pipelines from scratch. Early partners including Salesforce and ServiceNow report 40% accuracy improvements on customer support workflows. Pricing is tiered by compute usage and is generally available starting today.

articles.title: Meta Introduces Perception Encoder: A Universal Multimodal Embedding Model
articles.summary: Meta AI has published research on Perception Encoder, a unified model capable of generating embeddings across text, images, audio, and video in a shared latent space. The model outperforms domain-specific encoders on 14 of 18 cross-modal retrieval benchmarks. Meta has open-sourced the weights under a permissive license, calling it a step toward truly general-purpose multimodal AI.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Formal Warnings to Three Major AI Providers
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office issued formal compliance warnings to three unnamed AI providers for failing to meet transparency and risk-disclosure requirements under the AI Act's general-purpose model provisions. Companies have 60 days to submit remediation plans or face fines of up to 3% of global annual revenue. The action marks the first real enforcement test of Europe's landmark AI regulation.

articles.title: Startup Cohere Launches RAG-Optimized Command R3 with Real-Time Web Grounding
articles.summary: Cohere announced Command R3, an enterprise-focused retrieval-augmented generation model that integrates real-time web search grounding alongside private document retrieval in a single inference call. The model is designed to reduce hallucinations in knowledge-intensive tasks by dynamically citing sources at the sentence level. Command R3 is available immediately via API with on-premises deployment options for regulated industries.

articles.title: MIT Researchers Demonstrate AI System That Detects Its Own Hallucinations in Real Time
articles.summary: A team at MIT CSAIL has developed a self-monitoring layer called HaloscoPe that attaches to any transformer-based LLM and flags potential hallucinations during generation before output is returned to the user. In controlled tests, the system reduced factual errors by 61% on medical and legal QA datasets with only a 12% increase in latency. The team plans to release code publicly and is in talks with healthcare AI vendors about deployment.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Gains Autonomous Task Scheduling and Calendar Integration
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to Copilot Studio that allows enterprise agents to autonomously schedule, reschedule, and prioritize tasks across Outlook, Teams, and third-party project management tools without requiring user confirmation for low-risk actions. The feature uses a confidence-scoring system to determine when to act autonomously versus when to prompt for human approval. The update is live for all Microsoft 365 Business and Enterprise subscribers as of this week.
